items.guidance: The loopback listens are in desktop/main.js and desktop/portInUse.js, which appear to belong to the Electron desktop wrapper rather than the Go server built by the Dockerfile. Confirm whether the Dockerfile builds or starts anything under desktop/. If it does not, report that these files are out of scope and check instead how the Go server's bind address is configured for the container, keeping port 3456.

This is a Go app, so package.json is the wrong place to look for a migration script. Search the Go source for where lib/pq is used and for any migration package, an automatic schema sync, or a CLI migrate subcommand. Report the exact file that runs migrations at startup, or the exact non-interactive command the production image can run.
